definitions.explanation: An extraordinary event that seems impossible to explain by natural or scientific laws.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{奇跡|きせき}だ。
{奇跡|きせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
{奇跡|きせき}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{助|たす}かった→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧。

notes:
{奇跡|きせき} refers to an extraordinary event that cannot be explained by natural causes or logic. It can describe literal divine intervention or, more commonly, something remarkably fortunate or unlikely.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {奇跡|きせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: a miracle happens
- {奇跡|きせき}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: miraculously
- {奇跡|きせき}{的|てき}な⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧: miraculous recovery
- {奇跡|きせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧: to believe in miracles
- {奇跡|きせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生還|せいかん}→生還：13566_seikan⟧: miraculous survival

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧: mystery, wonder (less dramatic)
- ⟦{驚異|きょうい}→驚異：14657_kyoui⟧: marvel, wonder (emphasizes amazement)

USAGE:
Often used figuratively in everyday speech for any surprisingly good outcome: {奇跡|きせき}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}った→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧ (I miraculously made it in time).
